definition: Designing the whole input package so the model sees the right role, facts, memory, constraints, and output shape.
Injecting trusted reference information so the model answers from known facts instead of guessing.
A short controlled summary of prior turns, decisions, or open items that must carry forward.
Current values such as today's date, account status, ticket ID, or live operational state.
A required structure for the answer so outputs stay consistent and reusable.
The finite working memory the model can attend to at once; too much text creates overload.
